Title: [JOURNEY] Passkey — add on Security page, sign out, sign in with passkey, land in own organization
Preconditions:
Build under test: platform 3.1091.0-pr-3144, storefront theme 2.61.0-pr-2601, Passkeys module 3.1000.0-pr-1, Customer module with customer#324 - the PRs of VCST-6121, merged 2026-10-28. On a stand without them the case is BLOCKED for the build, never FAIL, and is never re-based to the older behaviour.
CEREMONY: Chromium lanes only (playwright-chrome or playwright-edge, never firefox). Before the first step a WebAuthn virtual authenticator is set up through the Chrome DevTools Protocol: WebAuthn.enable, then WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator {protocol: ctap2, transport: internal, hasResidentKey: true, hasUserVerification: true, isUserVerified: true, automaticPresenceSimulation: true}; capture authenticatorId; it is removed in Cleanup. On the Edge lane the window needs focus (select the tab) before every create or get, or the ceremony silently does nothing.
Persona @td(PK_BUYER.email) (B2B buyer of {{STORE_ID}}, one organization) is seeded by scripts/seed-data/auth/seed-passkey.mjs; re-arm it before the run with npm run seed:passkey (unlock, failed-attempt count 0, leftover passkeys removed). The case registers its own passkeys in the virtual authenticator and deletes every passkey it created in Cleanup.
Runs ALONE: store {{STORE_ID}} must have its Passkey authentication scheme active at the start. The store-scheme cases of the passkey suites flip that store-wide scheme; the exclusiveGroup store-setting:Passkey separates only the members of that group from each other, so any other sign-in suite on {{STORE_ID}} can still run beside this case - schedule it alone.
State under test: @td(PK_BUYER.email) has NO passkey at the start and belongs to one organization, @td(PK_ORG_MAIN.name); the Security page and the sign-in page are on the deployed theme with /account/security.
